newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar gives back gains near close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar gives back gains near close.

text.p: White sugar futures turned round gains of around $1.50 just before Monday's close as the New York market held trading interest ahead of the October raws expiry, traders said.
Volume picked up from earlier thin levels so that by the 1730 GMT close the December contract had traded 468 lots and the March 414 lots as the two front months dominated business.
December closed at $325.00 unchanged from Friday while March was at $322.20, up $0.90.

"It's quiet and it (December) has taken a bit of a bounce back in a reaction to the last week. It had come off and obviously it was going to stop," one trader said referring to the spot contract's low of $324.00 hit on Friday.
The main interest was in the New York market, where the October contract expires at close of business.
"It's not going to be a special one," the trader said.
Activity on the Paris market was stagnant with just 41 lots traded of the December contract, up 80 cents at $325.50.
